messages:
Alex: Quick sync — coordinating LangChain + LlamaIndex connector launch with our HW partner for Dedicated GPU SKUs. Need to align marketplace listing requirements, HW pricing tiers, and a joint announcement window. Who can own the marketplace cert checklist? :mega:

Maya: I can take marketplace cert. Need docs for required security attestations, screenshots, and sample deployment manifests. What timeline are we aiming for?

Alex: Targeting internal beta the week of May 4 and public listing May 18. Flexible if pricing negotiation takes longer.

Ben: For pricing, propose publishing two SKU families: Dedicated-Standard (1–4 GPUs) and Dedicated-High (8+). We should include per-instance QPS benchmarks + suggested per-hour list price. I'll draft a matrix. Quick CSV skeleton below:
```
sku, gpus, spot_eligible, monthly_commit_usd, suggested_list_price_per_hour
Dedicated-Standard, 1-4, yes, 20000, 2.50
Dedicated-High, 8, no, 80000, 10.00
```

Sophia: Marketplace requires a short demo video (1 min), tech contact, SOC/ISO copies, and a deployment architecture diagram. Can eng-infra produce a simplified PNG by Thursday?

Jorge: Legal note — any joint announcement needs partner approval on messaging and logo usage. I'll circulate an MSA addendum and a logo sign-off form. Also confirm whether the partner prefers a co-branded launch or a gated joint blog.

Alex: Action items: Maya -> cert checklist + marketplace draft by EOD Tue; Ben -> pricing matrix + perf numbers by Fri; Sophia -> diag + demo by Thu; Jorge -> legal draft + signatures by next Wed. I'll sync with marketing on announcement options.

Maya: Also flag from LangChain side: they want a small "adapter example" showing run() + streaming with our SDK. We should include a sample repo link and a CI badge on the marketplace page.

Ben: On perf numbers — can we get 500-token chat latency and a 2k-token throughput run on staging? Need those to justify the price tiers. Eng-runtime/infra, can we schedule smoke perf this week? @Sophia, pinging infra.

PartnerBot: Partner staging cluster created: https://partners.redwood.example/staging/abcd1234 — creds DM'd to integration leads.

Sophia: Acknowledged. I'll queue perf runs first thing tomorrow and post results here.

Alex: Thanks all. I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for go-to-market readiness and announcement timing. :thumbsup:
